title: Funje
description: Funje is a Angola classic prepared with cassava flour. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 10 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Add processed cassava flour slowly to boiling water, stirring strongly until the funje becomes a smooth, elastic paste.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
